verdicts.reason: Both are essentially the same failed leaderboard. The headline is a five-line block crammed against the left edge, and it is taller than the CTA. The body copy, badges and legal text are shrunk to an illegible thread. The SUNSET SALE ribbon is jammed against the badges, the product is a tiny smudge, and the missing-asset box is still visible on the right. In A, the SOLSTICE logo looks more garbled and collides with the product, while in B it reads slightly cleaner. That is a marginal difference between two unusable layouts.
